paragraphs: Blitz sells AI software that screens permit applications for completeness and reviews building plans against code. The platform is built specifically for cities, counties and government departments. Review types run from survey and zoning through site plan work and residential and commercial building permits.

Incoming applications are screened automatically for missing material. Code compliance diagnostics are customized to state and local code amendments. Plans are also evaluated against zoning regulations, with non-compliance marked directly in the plan set. Every finding is tied to a code reference and a sheet location, which the company presents as auditable output rather than a vague summary. The final decision stays with the qualified human reviewer, and re-checks after fixes are part of the standard service.

Users sit across development services departments including planning, building and engineering. The company says it can be deployed in any city or county regardless of size. It integrates with most major permitting systems and mark-up tools. Blitz says it was founded to transform local government operations through AI. The site lists a Tampa Bay Innovation Award 2025 GovTech win.
